text: Agent has its own computer with file system and terminal, letting it write code and build custom tools a task needs
quote: If a task needs a tool that doesn't exist, your agent builds it for you.

text: Users can create and customize a personalized avatar with a unique name and style for their agent
quote: Creating our own avatar, naming it, and giving it a unique style has become one of the core features people light up about most.

text: A Goals tab tracks the agent's ongoing tasks, which users can view or discuss directly in chat
quote: The Goals tab is where Muse keeps track of all this for you, and you can interact directly there or talk to it about these tasks in chat.

text: Side chats let users keep separate conversation context for specific topics or projects
quote: some people still wanted separate context for certain topics — which made sense as projects grew more complex. So we built side chats.

text: Tapping the avatar shows a full activity log plus the permissions the user has approved for the agent
quote: Tapping on your Muse avatar will show you its full activity log as well as permissions you’ve approved.
